Dear Customer,

We have reviewed your request for account closure and erasure of personal data.

Regrettably, we are unable to process your deletion request at this time. Our records indicate that you have an active disputed transaction and an unsettled outstanding credit balance on your account.

Under Section 12 of the DPDPA, erasure rights do not apply where personal data is required for the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims, or for the performance of an active contractual relationship.

Your request is therefore refused pending the complete settlement of your account liabilities.

Sincerely,
Customer Grievance Redressal
